p0_property_licences.interpretation: Utility is licensed capability by capability. Calibration pairs estimate natural real-to-real variation; disjoint TRAIN qualification pairs issue the licence. TEST is never used to select margins or licences.

missingness.semantic_contract: Under mask_and_zero_impute, each affected variable receives a binary __nonfinite_mask indicator before NaN/+inf/-inf values are replaced by zero. Observed zero and an imputed zero therefore remain distinguishable.

schema_and_scopes.tier_activity_basis: non-zero rate among observed entries only

learned_scope.selection_rule: Admissible task targets first, followed by round-robin tier/signal-balanced TRAIN variability ranking; observability masks and identifier-like fields excluded.

generator_registry.fit_validity_contract: Scientific fit validity is determined by convergence, held-out TRAIN health, support, variation, and sparsity checks. Poor C2ST or utility is a valid negative quality result, not by itself a degenerate fit.

property_license.temporal_utility: order_preserving=True and capability-specific P0 temporal licence passes
property_license.release_candidate: release_eligible=True; real anchors are never release candidates

learned_model_scope.selection_rule: Admissible task targets first, followed by round-robin tier/signal-balanced TRAIN variability ranking; observability masks and identifier-like fields excluded.
